description: Generate the PCB with the IterxAI desktop board engine (same code as the desktop app; runs headless in the IterxAI runtime when the desktop is closed). mode: prototype adopts the first-version board (run once first), generate (default) lays out, autoroutes, runs DRC and writes Gerber/drill/JLC package, reroute re-routes the saved board, layout only places, board skips the JLC package. Gate failures (e.g. FIRMWARE_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED, PROTOTYPE_REQUIRED) keep the saved board and return error.fix with the next step.

doubleSided.description: Allow components on both board sides.

handoffOnly.description: Only rebuild Gerber/JLC files from the saved board.

process.description: Copper layers available to the router.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

name: generate_board
